Name: Nyapu Style Nora the Herpetologist
Author: nugmods
Description:
Hey all! I know there are already several of these out there from several talented artists, so pick your fav! I started these Nora portraits last year while she was still in beta and wasn't happy with them at the time, but since I've learned a lot since then, I decided to touch them up and release them anyway! Assets are one part Nyapu's, one part the original mod's, and one final part my own hand-drawn edits.

[b]Install Instructions:[/b]

Just put the Content Patcher mod in your mods folder.

[b]Credits:
